posts.title: Complete Guide to Home Nursing Services in Lucknow
posts.excerpt: How Lucknow families choose a GDA attendant, a nurse shift, or a procedure visit, and what to confirm before someone enters the home.
posts.body:
Home nursing in Lucknow usually means one of three bookings: a GDA attendant for daily living, a nurse for a shift, or a nurse for a single task such as an injection, dressing, IV, or catheter care.

A GDA attendant helps with bathing, meals, mobility, and company. That role does not include injections or IV fluids. A 12-hour GDA shift on this site is listed at ₹650 where the service page shows that rate. A 12-hour registered-nurse shift is a different booking, listed at ₹1,200.

Before you confirm, ask three things. Who is coming, and is that person a GDA attendant or a nurse? What does the fee include? Which items, such as syringes, dressings, or IV fluids, will you need to arrange?

Share the patient's age, the locality, whether you prefer male or female staff, and the hours. Mson Nursing Services confirms those details from its Indira Nagar office before staff are sent. Call 9807925369 or 8894654090.

Home nursing is support at the address you give. It is not an emergency department. Chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding, a seizure, or collapse needs emergency medical services.

This guide is written by the Mson Nursing Services care desk in Lucknow. It describes how to book. It is not a diagnosis for a specific patient.

posts.title: Elder Care at Home: Safety, Hygiene & Daily Routines
posts.excerpt: What Lucknow families should set up before an elder-care attendant starts: routine, hygiene, mobility, and when a nurse is the better booking.
posts.body:
Elder care at home works when the routine is clear. Write down wake time, meals, medicines the family already manages, bathing preference, and how the person moves from bed to chair.

A GDA elder-care shift on this site is listed at ₹650 for 12 hours where that fee is printed. The attendant helps with daily living. If the older person needs injections, wound dressing, or an IV, book a nurse visit as well.

Reduce falls by keeping the path to the bathroom clear, using the footwear the person already wears safely, and agreeing who helps with transfers. The attendant should follow that plan, not invent a new exercise programme.

Call the coordinator if the attendant is late, if the older person refuses care, or if you need a replacement. The desk number is 9807925369, with 8894654090 as the second line.

Seek urgent care for a new fall with head injury, sudden weakness on one side, chest pain, or breathing difficulty. An attendant at home cannot replace that response.

This article is from the Mson Nursing Services care desk in Lucknow. It is planning advice for families, not a medical assessment of a parent or grandparent.

posts.title: Injections, IV Drip & Catheter Care at Your Doorstep
posts.excerpt: When a Lucknow nurse visit can cover an injection, TT, IV drip, or catheter change, and what must be prescribed first.
posts.body:
A home nurse can give an injection, set up an IV, dress a wound, or change a catheter when that task has already been decided by a doctor and someone is at home to receive the nurse.

On this website, many injection visits are listed at ₹299 and TT visits at ₹299. IV cannula or line visits are often ₹299 to ₹350. IV fluids or IV therapy are listed at ₹550 where the page says the drip follows a prescription. Catheter care is listed at ₹350 on the matching service page. Always read the fee on that page before you book, because consumables are usually extra.

The nurse does not choose the drug, the drip, or the catheter size. Keep the prescription, and any items the clinic told you to buy, ready before the visit. The page titled Doctor Injection at Home is still a nurse visit for an injection a doctor has prescribed. It is not a doctor consultation at the house.

Book on 9807925369. Say the procedure, the patient's age, the locality, and whether a female nurse is required. The coordinator confirms the fee and the consumables before the nurse leaves the Indira Nagar desk.

Do not wait for a home visit if there is chest pain, severe breathlessness, heavy bleeding, a seizure, or collapse. Those need emergency medical services.

This note is published by Mson Nursing Services, Lucknow, so families know how procedure visits are booked. It does not replace the doctor's instruction for a named patient.
